endpoints.iem_asos_1min_5min: NOT USED: mesonet.agron.iastate.edu returned a 302 to iowamesonet.github.io/sorry/?mode=blocked for this box IP on 2026-09-24

poll_intervals_s.kalshi_trades: continuous single-poll queue, list-budget paced (book-changed markets first; every market at least every 1800 s in Phase A / 3600 s in Phase B, else budget_shortfall gap)

kalshi_budget.phase_A: min 6.0 s between Kalshi GETs (<=10 rpm); list endpoints (events list, trades, series) >= 15 s apart (<=4 rpm)
kalshi_budget.phase_B: 2026-09-27T16:30Z to 2026-10-02T06:15Z (automatic time switch): min 12.0 s (<=5 rpm); list >= 30 s apart (<=2 rpm)
kalshi_budget.tonight_audit_window: until 2026-09-25T03:10Z: min 9.0 s spacing and list >= 60 s apart (a separate <=3 rpm audit counts inside this slice)
kalshi_budget.force_phase_B: touch FORCE_PHASE_B in this directory to drop to Phase B caps immediately (tripwire if the ADMIT-1 recorder logs a 429)
kalshi_budget.backoff: honor Retry-After, else per-endpoint-class cooldown 30/60/120/240 s capped 600, reset after one success; no immediate retries (a failed poll is a gap; the next scheduled poll is the single retry)
kalshi_budget.penalty: +2 s spacing per 429 in the trailing 30 min (cap +10 s)
kalshi_budget.storm: >=3 429s in 10 min -> pause all Kalshi GETs 600 s, log PAUSE_429_STORM
logs: logs/kalshi_429.jsonl (one line per 429: ts_utc, poller, path, status, retry_after, spacing_now_s, cooldown_s)
logs/kalshi_hourly.jsonl (requests, ok, http_429 per UTC hour)

rules.receipt_timestamp: received_at (UTC, box clock at receipt) on every stored record; source timestamp fields and raw bodies stored untouched
rules.prospective_only: nothing before archive_started_at counts; trades min_ts starts at archive_started_at; CLI/CF6 products already listed before start are indexed as pre_archive_baseline and their bodies NOT fetched; obs with source timestamp < start flagged pre_archive_start=1
rules.separate_from_admit1_and_pit_at_cle: separate DB (weather-nowcast/archive.sqlite) and processes; never touches astra-capture/prospective/ or record.py / admit1_supervisor.sh
